notes.title: Vigor hotfix patch 23.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Weapon swap button would not always select the secondary weapon
[*] Fixed: Unexploded missile was not rewarding XP. It now awards 200 XP upon successful defusal
[*] Fixed: Removed invisible collisions on Fjellkanten and Brodalen Bridges, making parts of the maps inaccessible
[*] Fixed: Holograms of consumable items would not disappear sometimes
[*] Fixed: Unfinished house interior on Grontheim is no longer accessible
[*] Fixed: When a player dies from the Unexploded Missile radiation, the correct cause of death is shown in the Rewards Screen
[*] Fixed: Crafting prompt when loading a preset containing a missing item did not work
[*] Fixed: Crafting challenge for Impact Grenades could be completed by crafting other consumables as well
[/list]

notes.title: Vigor - Meltdown Update 22.0
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=gLC6gqGQkdQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Main Features & New Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Meltdown Season has arrived to the Battle Pass
[*] Remember previous Seasons with new Action Figure collectibles
[*] Brand new Shelter improvement! Upgrade Wardrobe to access multiple loadout presets
[*] New Cosmetics Crate
[*] New Seasonal Challenges added
[*] New Premium Pack: Doomsday Raider
[/list]


[b]Gameplay & Visuals[/b]

[list]
[*] Added: New sounds for the Locked Container
[*] Added: New ambient sounds (including rain and boat rumble)
[*] Changed: Scoreboards reworked for Elimination and Shootout
[*] Changed: Rifle category split into Rifle and Sniper Rifle categories
[*] Changed: Maximum limit for resources is now 999,999,999
[*] Tweaked: XP value of extracted resources now better reflects their rarity
[*] Tweaked: Sudden change of movement
[*] Tweaked: Matchmaking system, with improved matchmaking times and better player matches
[*] Fixed: "Last Played With" list updating in real time during an Encounter
[*] Fixed: Mixed buttons for Booby Trap defusal
[*] Fixed: Several locations where player could get stuck
[*] Fixed: Various issues affecting Cosmetics
[*] Fixed: Various volume settings
[*] Fixed: Various Weapon Skin issues
[*] Fixed: Various UI issues
[*] Fixed: Multiple crash instances
[*] Fixed: Match results sometimes not showing
[*] Fixed: Several localization issues
[*] Fixed: Locked exits not unlocking
[*] Fixed: Locked exits not deducting resources for unlocking
[*] Fixed: FPS drops when shooting water barrels
[*] Fixed: Radiation killing player in Encounter exits
[*] Fixed: Stamina drain bug when Comm Station is used to increase Airdrop weight
[*] Fixed: Weapon Skin preview issues
[*] Fixed: Antibiotics not counting towards the 'Just Like New' challenge
[/list]


[b]Known Issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Loud water sounds on Eikevjen
[*] Some clipping of Cosmetics
[*] Action figure on Brodalen Bridges cannot be picked up
[*] "Box of Plants full" notification appears when matchmaking with full Scrap Bin
[*] Teammate does not see the purchased Insurance Ticket if they join the lobby later
[*] Map still showing after leaving spectator mode with the map open
[*] Maximum limit warning messages are not showing for building materials
[*] Cannot bind default keys to different positions (Steam)
[*] Comm station voice line hinting a change of airdrop location after airdrop already fell
[*] Fiske Fabrikk Duo Vault switch in tunnels has blocked interactions
[/list]


[b]Bug Reports[/b]

Found a bug not listed here? Let us know through our Feedback Tracker:
https://feedback.bistudio.com/project/view/80/

notes.title: A new patch brings fixes to the Outlands!
notes.notes:
Hei Outlanders,

We're bringing some fixes to the Outlands! With a focus on crashes and improving your experience in-game, here is the changelog for this patch:

[list]
[*] Shelter UI to prevent getting stuck in different screens/menus
[*] Server-side fixes to lessen crashes
[*] Overlay fixes
[*] Addition of Consumable Plans to the Store
[/list]

Keep the feedback rolling so that we can keep on working on fixes behind the scenes. See you in the Outlands!

notes.title: The Full Release Is Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
Hei Outlanders! 🍅

The time has come. The full free-to-play release of Vigor is arriving next week! You can still get your hands on the Reinforcements Pack, now 50% off on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/sub/1046264/

It includes a uniform, unique title, weapons, and consumables that you’ll keep in the full release.

You can also look forward to a brand-new Season—Vigor Chronicles: Genesis. Read more about it below, and watch the trailer that reveals the theme.

[previewyoutube=hq0zTpCopaM;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfold the Chronicles and revel in this genesis! A new era has reached the Outlands, full of new and exciting possibilities! In this update, you can explore Eikevjen in Encounters, take a shot at the new Weapon Overhaul, and progress through a Battle Pass inspired by 80s action movies.

We can't wait to meet you all in the Outlands! Are you ready to survive the apocalypse?
